summary: Prepare the defence, react to incoming threats, and hold until Lancer reaches the bridgehead.
rationale: A real-time silent gameplay excerpt shows the relief tanks at the crossing and the transition from the counterattack to the handover. Command-driven trials and completion checks assess mechanics; this is not a claim of human playtesting.

capture.simulation: fixed 30 Hz, mission autoplay with player HUD
capture.encode: ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i frame_%d.png -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 34 -b:v 0 -deadline good -cpu-used 4 -threads 2 -row-mt 1 -an relief.webm
